finding: Three data-driven scans, 634 rules classed, none promising. The failures are not alike. Energy: two instruments, best check-row t 1.43: no breadth, so no power. Funds: the rules' check-row t are centred at -0.56 and 55 of 102 losers were positive before costs: a 3 basis point cost is larger than what these methods find at a daily horizon. Perpetuals: 69 positives, the best at t 2.76 among 174 distinct behaviours, which is what chance gives; 48 of 72 losers lost only after costs of 7 to 13 basis points; and 22 of the 24 cross-sectional places went to funding rankings, a closed family, so no ranking on past returns or volatility was looked at out of sample.
mistake_found: The scan gives its places by strength on the fit rows, so one strong and already closed family crowded out every other ranking. A missing result was at risk of being read as a negative one.
next: Fill the holes with a directed test of the cells never looked at (the lab does this itself from its coverage map, lab-cycle-1.1.0), rather than scanning the panels again.
